annotations.title: TikTok Lead Ads terms: check or accept

description: TikTok’s Lead Generation Ads terms for an ad account — whether they are accepted, and the link to read them. TikTok refuses every Instant-Form lead ad (create_tiktok_ads_ad with pageId) until the ad account has accepted them. Without confirm this only READS and changes nothing. Accepting is the ADVERTISER’s legal act: show the user the terms link and pass confirm:true ONLY after they say they accept. The result is read back from TikTok. Free.

confirm.description: true = accept the terms on the user’s behalf — only after they have seen the link and said yes
